extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction
extraction.description: We introduce Arabic-Nougat, a suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. Building on Meta’s Nougat architecture, Arabic-Nougat includes three specialized models: arabic-small-nougat, arabic-base-nougat, and arabic-large-nougat. These models are fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset, arabic-img2md, consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.publisher: Faculty of Engineering Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt
extraction.citeAs: Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset used for training, arabic-img2md, contains 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. Additionally, a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens (arabic-books) was extracted from over 8,500 books using the SOTA model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: HTML content was converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted from these PDFs to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The input image size of 896 × 672 pixels is progressively reduced to 224 × 168, 112 × 84, 56 × 42, and finally 28 × 21, resulting in 588 tokens. The Aranizer-PBE-86k tokenizer was used to optimize tokenization efficiency.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, generated automatically by scraping HTML and extracting Markdown text. No manual human annotation is described.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Aranizer-PBE-86k tokenizer, Donut Vision Encoder, MBART transformer-based decoder
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All models and datasets are open-sourced. The implementation is available at https://github.com/MohamedAliRashad/arabic-nougat. Datasets are hosted on Hugging Face.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work contributes to the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic and provides resources for downstream NLP tasks. It addresses challenges in parsing non-Latin scripts.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Hallucination in arabic-small-nougat; repetition issues in larger models; dataset biases limiting generalization to other domains; scalability challenges due to computational resources; cross-script generalization not extensively tested; difficulties with complex layouts containing dense tables, charts, or images.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of OCR models for Arabic book pages; converting Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text; downstream NLP tasks.
